      end if;
      return Result;
   end From_JSON;

with UARP.Multipart;

package body UARP.API.Uploads is

   package JS renames UARP.JSON_Support;

   procedure Delete
     (Self : Client_Type;
      Upload_Id : String;
      Options : Request_Options := UARP.Client.Default_Options)
   is
   begin
      UARP.Client.Call_And_Discard
         (Self,
          "DELETE",
          "/uploads/" & UARP.Types.Encode_Path_Segment (Upload_Id),
          Options => Options);
   end Delete;

   function Download_Bundle
     (Self : Client_Type;
      Upload_Id : String;
      Options : Request_Options := UARP.Client.Default_Options)
      return UARP.Types.Text
   is
   begin
      return UARP.Client.Call_Raw
         (Self,
          "GET",
          "/uploads/" & UARP.Types.Encode_Path_Segment (Upload_Id) & "/content",
          Options => Options);
   end Download_Bundle;

   function Get_Metrics
     (Self : Client_Type;
      Options : Request_Options := UARP.Client.Default_Options)
      return UARP.Types.Text
   is
   begin
      return UARP.Client.Call_Raw
         (Self,
          "GET",
          "/metrics",
          Options => Options);
   end Get_Metrics;

   function Get_Upload_Metadata
     (Self : Client_Type;
      Upload_Id : String;
      Options : Request_Options := UARP.Client.Default_Options)
      return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value
   is
   begin
      return UARP.Client.Call
         (Self,
          "GET",
          "/uploads/" & UARP.Types.Encode_Path_Segment (Upload_Id),
          Options => Options);
   end Get_Upload_Metadata;

   function Upload_Bundle
     (Self : Client_Type;
      Payload : UARP.Models.Upload_Bundle_Request;
      Options : Request_Options := UARP.Client.Default_Options)
      return UARP.Models.Upload_Bundle_Response
   is
   begin
      declare
         Form : UARP.Multipart.Builder;
      begin
         UARP.Multipart.Reset (Form);
         UARP.Multipart.Add_Field (Form, "manifest", UARP.Types.SU.To_String (Payload.Manifest));
         UARP.Multipart.Add_File (Form, "artifact", "artifact", UARP.Types.SU.To_String (Payload.Artifact));
         if Payload.Has_Sha256 then
            UARP.Multipart.Add_Field (Form, "sha256", UARP.Types.SU.To_String (Payload.Sha256));
         end if;
         declare
            Raw_Body : constant UARP.Types.Text := UARP.Client.Call_Raw
               (Self,
                "POST",
                "/uploads",
                Options => Options,
                Payload => UARP.Types.SU.To_String (UARP.Multipart.Body_Text (Form)),
                Has_Payload => True,
                Content_Type => UARP.Multipart.Content_Type (Form));
         begin
            return UARP.Models.From_JSON (JS.Parse (UARP.Types.SU.To_String (Raw_Body)));
         end;
      end;
   end Upload_Bundle;
end UARP.API.Uploads;
